payload.blocks: Every code land on main, including phase 2 of this plan (branch heads-stable-and-able/p02c, ready and green). Phase 4 waits on q-3f6qen2bsd anyway.
payload.headline: Main's land gate is red on 48 citation findings from bddb4fe0d; who fixes them so code lands can pass?

parts.cause: The recent docs commits that gave decision headings their D-ADR id (bddb4fe0d, edd3e4486, 0044018d1) left citations the drift check now flags; the first land gate runs that test for any src/apps/packages/test change, so no code land can pass.

options.does: whoever landed bddb4fe0d adds the glosses (or refreshes the checked-in baseline if the findings are accepted) in one docs commit
options.gain: main green again; every waiting code land proceeds unchanged
options.label: Docs author fixes the citations

options.does: regenerate the drift baseline to accept the 48 findings
options.label: Refresh the baseline only

parts.recommendation: Docs author fixes the citations; then this lead retries the land of heads-stable-and-able/p02c as is.

scope.allows: A docs or baseline commit that clears the 48 citation-drift findings on main.
scope.forbids: Weakening or skipping the land gate, and any change to this plan's branch.

parts.what: fgos land of heads-stable-and-able/p02c failed land-gate-failed: test/scripts/check-decision-citation-drift.test.mjs 'CLI run against the real repo root, with the checked-in baseline, exits 0' reports 48 findings, e.g. docs/platform/platform-foundations.md:494 'cites ADR0001 with no gloss', docs/platform/git/spec.md:962, docs/platform/event-store/spec.md:768. Full log: .fgos/runtime/land/land-1208739-1795319603314350840-2.log. The branch changes none of those files.
